item.title: [LU-20685] interop sanity test_230w: directory restripe count mismatch with 2.15 server
item.description:
This issue was created by maloo for Andreas Dilger <adilger@dilger.ca>

This issue relates to the following test suite run:
https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/e7e79f88-b555-4a79-9fc6-0f9a9d1fd879

test_230w failed with the following error when running with a 2.15 server with multiple MDTs:

lfs migrate: cb_migrate_mdt_fini: error completing migration of /mnt/lustre/d230w.sanity: Invalid argument (22)
d230w.sanity stripe count mismatch

Test session details:

Interop

Client
Lustre: 2.17.57.103
Branch: master
Build: https://build.whamcloud.com/job/lustre-reviews/130753
Kernel: 5.14.0-611.5.1.el9_7.x86_64

Server
Lustre: 2.15.8
Branch: b2_15
Build: https://build.whamcloud.com/job/lustre-b2_15/117
Kernel: 4.18.0-553.82.1.el8_lustre.x86_64

The test is skipped when run with MDSCOUNT=1 (which is unfortunately the default for branch landing interop sessions), so it only fails when explicitly run with "Test-Parameters: testlist=sanity serverversion=2.15".

Both MDS nodes report messages like:

[ 9601.587759] Lustre: DEBUG MARKER: == sanity test 230v: subdir migrated to the MDT where its parent is located ========================================================== 05:11:09 (1788325869)
[ 9602.473089] LustreError: 616183:0:(mdt_xattr.c:435:mdt_dir_layout_update()) lustre-MDT0000: [0x2000061c1:0x364a:0x0] migrate mdt hash mismatch 2181038083 != 33554432
[ 9603.023701] LustreError: 616183:0:(mdt_xattr.c:435:mdt_dir_layout_update()) lustre-MDT0002: [0x280002346:0x14c5:0x0] migrate mdt hash mismatch 2181038083 != 33554432
[ 9603.026088] LustreError: 616183:0:(mdt_xattr.c:435:mdt_dir_layout_update()) Skipped 3 previous similar messages
[ 9604.284707] LustreError: 616183:0:(mdt_xattr.c:435:mdt_dir_layout_update()) lustre-MDT0000: [0x2000061c1:0x3656:0x0] migrate mdt hash mismatch 2181038083 != 33554432
[ 9604.287072] LustreError: 616183:0:(mdt_xattr.c:435:mdt_dir_layout_update()) Skipped 12 previous similar messages
[ 9606.369832] LustreError: 607762:0:(mdt_xattr.c:435:mdt_dir_layout_update()) lustre-MDT0000: [0x2000061c1:0x3664:0x0] migrate mdt hash mismatch 2181038083 != 33554432

These hash values are unfortunately printed as decimal (which should also be fixed), but in hex they are 0x82000003 = LMV_HASH_FLAG_MIGRATION|LMV_HASH_FLAG_FIXED|LMV_HASH_TYPE_CRUSH, and 0x2000000 = LMV_HASH_FLAG_FIXED, so it looks like this is a real protocol interop issue with 2.15 related to "lfs migrate -m".

It might relate to patch https://review.whamcloud.com/58932 ("LU-18904 llite: set hash fnv_1a_64 for old server") which was landed in commit v2_16_58-42-g19e6393c24 and claims an interop fix for 2.12 by checking for OBD_CONNECT2_CRUSH, or patch https://review.whamcloud.com/57784 ("LU-18639 dne: a correct check for dir split") which changed test_230p, but there seems to be something else that is is needed (different connect flag or hash version check).

Especially since 2.18 is an LTS release, it needs to interoperate properly with the previous LTS release 2.15.

status.description: The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.

comments.comment:
Hi Lai, could you please take a look.

It appears that there is something wrong with lfs migrate -m interop with 2.15 servers.
I will add this to always_except because it is causing testing interop failures for other patches, but this appears to be a real interop issue and not just a test script/feature problem.
Could this relate to the issue that emoly.liu fixed in patch https://review.whamcloud.com/67439 ("LU-20428 lod: init fld range type before lod_fld_lookup")?

+1 on master+b2_15 servers: https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sets/630205d3-530a-4e79-bca5-5d100c9d8e8f

This seems to relate to the landing of Oleg's patch commit v2_17_58-1-g461c24974158 ("llite: Remove the 2.17.58 timebomb") that broke interop with 2.15 servers and landed on 2026-09-02. There is patch https://review.whamcloud.com/69153 ("LU-20779 revert: 'llite: Remove the 2.17.58 timebomb'") that reverts that change and should restore the 2.15 interop (with corrections to the issues that caused that code to be removed).

A correction on the cause: this is not the 2.17.58 timebomb removal (461c249741, LU-20779), which only touched the mkdir -EREMOTE retry in ll_new_node(). The same failure was reported earlier in LU-19542 and seen on 2025-10-29 (sanity test_230w, change 62059, 2.15 servers), with the same MDS message: "migrate mdt hash mismatch 2181038083 != 33554432". Andreas's 2026-10-13 failure shows the same line.

Cause: since LU-17810 (2.16.51), lfs migrate -m sets LMV_HASH_FLAG_FIXED in lum_hash_type, and that goes to the MDS in the final trusted.lmv setxattr (cb_migrate_mdt_fini() in liblustreapi.c). A 2.15 MDS compares the hash type in mdt_dir_layout_update() without masking the flags, so every multi-stripe migrate fails there with EINVAL. 2.16 and later servers mask it (LU-12273). The client strips the flag only for servers without OBD_CONNECT2_CRUSH, and 2.15 has that flag.

Fix: on the client, send only the hash type (lum_hash_type & LMV_HASH_TYPE_MASK) in that final setxattr in cb_migrate_mdt_fini(); master servers mask the flags anyway. Masking on b2_15 is worth backporting as well, but on its own it does not help 2.15.8 and older servers already in the field.

"patrick bot <patrick-bot@mulberrytree.us>" uploaded a new patch: https://review.whamcloud.com/c/fs/lustre-release/+/69693
Subject: LU-20685 utils: mask hash flags when completing dir migration
Project: fs/lustre-release
